Sharing your screen needs Windows 10 version 2004 or later. You can still watch other people's screens.
Sharing your screen on Linux needs PipeWire and xdg-desktop-portal with a ScreenCast backend (xdg-desktop-portal-gnome, -kde or -wlr). You can still watch other people's screens.

Sharing your screen on macOS needs macOS 12.3 or later and the Screen Recording permission. Turn Basis on in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Screen Recording, then restart Basis. You can still watch other people's screens.
